name: Bluebarry Product Recommendation Quizzes for WooCommerce
author: bluebarry

sections.description:
bluebarry helps shoppers find the right product. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your bluebarry account.

With the plugin you can:

  • Show your bluebarry product quizzes anywhere on your store
  • Use bluebarry search, recommendations and product chat
  • Let shoppers add recommended products straight to their cart
  • Keep your products in sync with bluebarry
  • See which sales came from bluebarry

You build and design everything in your bluebarry account. The plugin puts it live on your store.

Get started

You need a bluebarry account. Start a free trial or see our pricing.

Help

  • Help center
  • Contact us or email contact@bluebarry.ai
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “bluebarry”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open bluebarry in your admin menu.
  4. Enter your Tenant ID and API key from your bluebarry account.
  5. Choose how to sync your products and follow the steps on the page.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. You need a bluebarry account to build your quizzes and other features. See our pricing.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin needs WooCommerce for product sync, add to cart and sales tracking.

How do I sync my products?

Open the bluebarry settings page, enter your Tenant ID and API key, and choose a sync method. Live sync sends changes as they happen. The CSV feed lets bluebarry pick up your catalog on a schedule.

Are variations included?

Yes. Variations, prices, stock and product attributes are all synced.

Does tracking respect cookie consent?

Yes. bluebarry reads Cookiebot, banners that support the WP Consent API (Complianz, CookieYes and others), banners that speak IAB TCF and Google Consent Mode. Until a shopper allows statistics cookies, bluebarry stores nothing on their device, doesn’t track them and doesn’t link their order to their visit. Search, quizzes and recommendations keep working. The orders themselves are your store’s records and sync to bluebarry either way, for the Orders page, flows and loyalty.

How do I place quiz buttons and recommendations?

Switch them on in your bluebarry account under Integrations > WooCommerce > On your store, and the plugin places them on your product and cart pages. To place them anywhere else, use the shortcodes: [bluebarry_quiz_button quiz="QUIZ ID"], [bluebarry_quiz_popup quiz="QUIZ ID"], [bluebarry_product_check], [bluebarry_recommendations block="BLOCK ID"] and [bluebarry_product_chat].

Where does product chat appear?

Once product chat is live in your bluebarry account, the floating chat button shows on the pages you pick under Where it shows. To show the open chat on a page instead, switch on its place under Integrations > WooCommerce > On your store (product pages, or above the products on your shop and category pages), or add the [bluebarry_product_chat] shortcode anywhere. A page with the open chat never also gets the button.
sections.changelog:
2.3.4

  • Respects Cookiebot without the WP Consent API: until a shopper allows statistics cookies, bluebarry stores no cookies on their device and doesn’t link their order to their visit
  • The rewards panel signs a shopper in through their store account only once its email is verified by a password setup or reset link; others get an emailed sign-in code
  • Product chat’s Where it shows and Never show on know cart, checkout and account pages
  • Products on backorder sync as orderable, not sold out
  • Recommendation blocks know what the cart is worth and how many of each product it holds, for cart conditions and rewards
  • Orders send their payment method and shipping country, for who a recommendation block reaches
  • The search bar’s logo links to your store’s home page
  • Popups, recommendations, product chat and search texts load only on pages that use them
  • The order import picks up where it stopped and says how far it got, and deactivating the plugin pauses its background jobs
  • Variations sync their own title, with the size or colour they are sold in, and search can show it on product cards. The CSV feed has it in a new variant_name column
  • Fix: a recommendation offer chosen by the cart (its value, a number of products, or products it must not hold) is checked again whenever the cart changes, and its coupon is removed once the cart no longer qualifies
  • Fix: a fixed amount off a recommended product comes off each of those products, not once off the cart
  • The product check button shows on every product with a product check quiz, with the text, colours, corner radius and width set on that quiz in bluebarry. Your theme’s CSS can still restyle it. A page shows one button: with [bluebarry_product_check] in a product’s description, the button shows there instead

2.3.3

  • Variations sync their product’s other attributes (material, finish) too, as the CSV feed already did
  • Products sync their extra gallery images, for image hover effects in search
  • Products sync their description
  • Changing a variable product’s name, images, description, categories, attributes or stock syncs its variations right away
  • Stock in bluebarry follows WooCommerce: products marked out of stock without stock tracking show as sold out, and stock a variable product shares with its variations updates them at checkout
  • After a full sync, attributes that hold one number per product become numbers in bluebarry (range filters and sorting), and those that hold one value per product become text
  • An attribute removed from a product, or from the product its variations take it from, is removed in bluebarry too

2.3.2

  • Fix: product attributes with the same name no longer overwrite each other
  • Two categories with the same name (Tops under Men and under Women, say) no longer share their products in bluebarry: they sync as “Men / Tops” and “Women / Tops”. Categories with a unique name keep their name

2.3.0

  • Every paid order from a shopper who used bluebarry is tracked, whether they used search, recommendations, product chat, a popup or a quiz
  • Orders paid by cash on delivery, bank transfer or check are tracked once they are paid
  • Orders are sent in the background, so checkout never waits for bluebarry
  • Respects your cookie banner through the WP Consent API
  • Orders count toward your search and popup experiments
  • bluebarry sees page views, product views and adds to the cart on your store, for recently viewed products, segments and follow-up emails
  • Popups can target product pages and the cart state on WooCommerce
  • Product chat knows the category page’s products and what is in the cart
  • Recommendation blocks update when the cart changes
  • Your orders go to bluebarry as they are paid, for best sellers, bought together, loyalty points, segments and the order placed email
  • Import the last 365 days of orders from bluebarry’s Orders page or the plugin settings, in small batches that keep your store fast
  • Abandoned checkout emails can remind shoppers who agreed to your emails
  • Switch on the product check button, product chat and recommendation blocks for product and cart pages in bluebarry, and the plugin places them: no theme editing
  • New shortcodes: [bluebarry_quiz_button], [bluebarry_quiz_popup], [bluebarry_product_check], [bluebarry_recommendations] and [bluebarry_product_chat]
  • On-site search is set up in bluebarry now: switch it on from the search configuration’s Launch step. The configuration you picked in the plugin before keeps working
  • bluebarry search results can replace your product search results page, switched on in bluebarry
  • Import your filterable product attributes as search filters in bluebarry
  • Discounts from quizzes and recommendations become a one-time coupon on the cart, only for the products they cover, once the shopper adds them
  • bluebarry collection pages on your category pages: a banner and quiz invitation around your theme’s product list, which can show each returning shopper their most relevant products first
  • Your product categories sync to bluebarry
  • WordPress’s Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data tools include what bluebarry holds for the shopper
  • Variations created through imports or the REST API sync right away
  • The settings page points to the right places in bluebarry Studio for your Tenant ID, API key and product feeds

2.2.0

  • Product chat can appear on your shop and category pages, or anywhere you add the [bluebarry_shopping_help] shortcode
  • Product chat knows which product, variation or category the shopper is looking at
  • Shoppers can add products to their cart from bluebarry search, recommendations and collection pages
  • A bluebarry quiz page on a subdomain of your store adds products straight to the shopper’s cart
  • A quiz on another website can add a whole set of products to the cart in one click
  • bluebarry loads faster on your store
  • The plugin reconnects right away when you change your API key
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1

2.1.0

  • Choose how to sync your products: live, or through a CSV feed that bluebarry picks up on a schedule
  • Simpler, step-by-step settings page
  • Switching sync method keeps your quiz filters and search working
  • Variation links open the product with that variation selected
  • Sync fixes

2.0.5

  • Better sync for large catalogs

2.0.4
